description: This file defines the UI screen for a local Ludo game, including game board, turn panel, and match setup dialogs. It utilizes Flutter widgets and state management via Provider.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: Stateless widget that initializes a provider for game controller and constructs the main game screen.

classes.name: _GameScreenBody
classes.description: Stateless widget that builds the core layout of the game, including the board and turn panel.

classes.name: _MatchSetupDialog
classes.description: Stateful widget that displays a dialog to configure a new game match (players and AI difficulty).

classes.name: _MatchSetupDialogState
classes.description: State object managing user input for the match setup dialog, handling selection of players and AI difficulty.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the respective widget, constructing UI components and layouts.
